title: Photon wavelength comparison
hints: Shortest wavelength means largest photon energy.
Look for the widest level separation.
Compare the result with each choice and check its sign, units, or underlying rule.
solution: Compare gaps in $1/n^2$: $4\to1$ has the largest listed gap.
statement:
Which hydrogen emission has the shortest wavelength?

[_]{a}

explanations: The upper level is lower than 4.
Ending at 2 releases less energy than ending at 1.
